source_value.trigger: Nothing the viewer does: the clip is an official screen-recorded walkthrough that plays itself. Inside it a drawn pointer performs the actions — it clicks the "Location 2nd Street Location" chip at 64.5s, picks "Austin Ecosystem" from the opened list at 66.5s, and travels down the left navigation (Home, Items & services, Online, Reports, Banking, POS systems) from 84s to 89s.
source_value.start_state: Black title card reading "Navigate Your Dashboard & Locate Reports" with the white Square logo bottom-right (0-4s).
source_value.end_state: Square Dashboard home for 2nd Street Location with the Performance date chip reading "Last year" and the pointer resting on "POS systems" at the foot of the left navigation (89-90.06s).
source_value.continuity: One 90.06s render at ~30 fps. Scenes are joined by hard cuts and cross-dissolves: the black title card cuts to a "Topics" card at ~5s, the topics list grows line by line ("Homepage Overview" and "Features & Settings" by 14.4s, "Data & Reports" added by 16s), and the monitor mock-up dissolves into the full-bleed browser dashboard at ~19-20s. Within a scene motion is continuous — the pointer glides, menus slide open, and after each data change the cards pass through grey skeleton placeholders (63.5s, 67.0-67.5s) before values render. No still-image interpolation.
source_value.interruption_or_reversal: Yes: at ~62.6s the pointer clicks the back arrow beside "Reports" in the report sub-navigation, the sub-navigation collapses back to the main sidebar by 62.75s and the Reports detail is replaced by the Home dashboard, which reloads through skeleton placeholders at 63.5s and finishes at ~63.75s.
source_value.feedback: Every action draws a visible answer. Opening the location chip at 65.0s reveals a "Filter Locations" search field over a list (2nd Street Location, Austin Ecosystem, Aux fleurs de la bergerie, Best Cut Nickname, Main Street Location, Market Street, Retail - Florist); the hovered row is highlighted at 66.5s; the chip then reads "Austin Ecosystem" at 67.0s and every Key Metrics figure reloads to $0.00 and 0 by 68.0s. On the Reports page a spinner shows at ~59s and is replaced by the rendered bar-and-area chart under the "Jan 1, 2024-Dec 31, 2024" heading by ~59.5s.
